ns2:section.sectionText: This section will be taught online. Students must have broadband access to the internet to participate. Please see http://business.illinois.edu/elearning-sites/vishal/ for more information. There will be one on-campus organizational meeting TBA to cover logistics and address any questions. This course will open to all students in the College of Business on Monday, April 15, 2013 and to the campus on Monday, April 22, 2013 at approximately 9:00 a.m. This is an elective course for undergraduate students pursuing the business minor.
